answer_1.quote: We evaluate the proposed SpeechUT on En-{De, Es, Fr} language pairs... our SpeechUT achieves the performance of 30.1, 33.6, and 41.4 BLEU scores... We also evaluate on LibriSpeech using WER.
answer_1.outputs: Transcribed text for ASR and translated text for speech translation

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the performance by the word error rate (WER) computed on LibriSpeech test-clean and test-other sets... we report the case-sensitive detokenized BLEU on tst-COMMON set.
